investigation_notes.Script Block: Get-ChildItem C:\Users -Recurse -Include *.kdbx,*.pst,*.docx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName,Length | Export-Csv C:\ProgramData\user_cache.csv -NoTypeInformation
investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell command was executed on FIN-SRV-01 that recursively enumerated user directories for .kdbx, .pst, and .docx files and exported the results to C:\ProgramData\user_cache.csv. The targeted file types include sensitive credential and mailbox file formats and the output is placed in a common system location, which is atypical for normal user activity. The action was performed by user m.laane on a financial server and shows characteristics of data discovery or consolidation that could precede exfiltration, so this alert is considered High Priority.
